clips.title: The story
paras: The Cantation of Manifestation is a specialized arcane incantation written on a parchment scroll, used by mages to reveal unseen magical anomalies. In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell provides it to apprentices investigating invisible magical entities haunting Algernon's shop in the Apothecarium.

The Cantation of Manifestation holds a focused spell designed to pierce magical veils and force incorporeal, invisible beings into the visible spectrum. Kept in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity near Anastasia Hartwell, the scroll is entrusted to capable mages tasked with containing rogue magical anomalies. When read aloud in an area suffering from arcane instability—such as Algernon's alchemical workshop in the Apothecarium—the words force stray rift spawns to materialize, allowing the caster to subdue and trap them within containment coffers for further study.
